title: Sar Barehna Fatima Ki Betiyan Roti Rahi
body:
Sar Barehna Fatima Ki Betiyan Roti Rahi
Phool Se Shanou Me Badhkar Rassiyan Roti Rahi
1.Nange Paa Bimar Ku Kantou Pa Chalwayaga
Zakhmi Pairou Se Lipat Kar Bedhiyan Roti Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Laasha-e-Abbas Khaime Me Nahin Laaye Hussain
Khoon Bhare Parcham Se Lipti Bebiyan Roti Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Berida Kufe Ke Bazarou Me Jab Laayi Gayi
Dhaaph Kar Baalou Se Muh Shehazadiyan Roti Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Dasht Me Besheer Zindan Me Sakina Chodh Gayi
Kukh Ujdhi Maa Ke Laabou Par Looriyan Roti Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Chodh Kar Qabre Sakina Jab Chale Alhe Haram
Shaam Ke Zindan Ki Tarikiyan Roti Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Fatima Sughra Ku Zainab Kuch Na De Payi Jawab
Bus Dikha Ke Usku Dhurou Ke Nasha Roti Rahi
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Umme Laila Ke Muqaddar Me Na Tha Fakhri Sukoon
Zandagi Bhar Sunke Awaaz-e-Azaan Roti Rahi
